bugs_found: transfer allows cross-currency transfers with no currency validation
transfer is not atomic: debit can occur before credit failure if account_to.balance update raises
transfer does not normalize/validate amount as Decimal, allowing type errors or non-finite/NaN behavior
compound_interest silently truncates fractional years and compounds_per_year via int()
loan_payment silently truncates fractional months via int()
money results are not quantized/rounded to currency precision, causing fractional-cent balances/payments
fx_convert accepts missing/zero/negative/non-finite exchange rates without validation
compound_interest allows negative principal without validation
apply_fee can return a negative net amount when fee_min exceeds amount
